{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Phrin remains |image = [[File:Phrin remains.png]] |release = [[18 October]] [[2004]] |update = Mortton Shades and Mage Armour |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = The remains of a deadly shade. |value = 1 |weight = 1.360 |exchange = Yes |id = 3398 }} [[File:Phrin remains detail.png|left|150px]] '''Phrin remains''' are an item found and used in the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] [[Minigames|minigame]]. To obtain these remains, the player must kill [[Phrin Shade|phrin shades]], located in the [[Shade Catacombs]]. To burn the phrin remains, the player needs some pyre logs (see table for more info) and a [[tinderbox]]. First place the pyre logs on a [[Funeral Pyre|funeral pyre]], followed by the phrin remains, then light the pyre. This will grant the player [[Firemaking]] and [[Prayer]] experience (see table). Once burned, a bronze or steel [[shade key]], or some [[coins]], will appear next to the pyre. The keys can be used to either enter the catacombs or open the corresponding coloured doors to chests containing valuable items. Coins and keys dropped by cremating these remains will not despawn for five minutes, and cannot be taken by other players during this time. When dropped by the player, they will despawn and become visible to others at the normal rate. {| class="wikitable" !Log Type !{{SCP|Firemaking}} Experience
